decisions.notes: P2 copy-asks-for-work-the-learner-does-not-do: measured on the real card path (derivePlaintextStarter -> deriveSyntaxCheckpoints -> describeCheckpoint) this candidate opens exactly three blanks, one bar per row; the cell text and the divider dashes stay locked. teaching.howTo asks for a divider row, and the match-check feedback asks to add a header row, a divider row and a body row. That feedback is what a learner sees after leaving a bar out, so it names work they were never asked to do. hints[0] describes how to read a table rather than what to type. P3 bus-named-by-colour-alone: `Green | Noon` under `Bus | Time` names the bus by a colour alone, one step more abstract than the peers (`Apples | 3`, `Tea | $2`, `Monday | Sunny`). Not incorrect - Green Line buses exist - but weak for Level 1 vocabulary. Either head the column `Route | Time` or use `Airport | Noon`. Level fit, vocabulary domain, one-syntax-per-problem and duplication all pass. Rejected because the shared teaching and hints ship with every candidate in this batch, so the copy findings are not separable per candidate.
